snippet.title: "Alebound" Early Access Gameplay Reveal #2
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3538800/Alebound/

Discord:https://discord.gg/NWTfkhFj

Patch Notes since previous trailer:

Update 0.4.0

-Adjusting skeletal enemy damage
-Added SFX to ice enemies
-Added ranged enemies
-Added telegraphed AOE attacks
-Added SFX to fire enemies
-Addressed a few more bugs regarding AI movement
-Tweaked character scaling

Update 0.3.5

-Increased enemy scaling
-Increased base movement speed by 25%
-Fixed AI getting stuck on rocks
-Implemented VFX for "Healing Strikes"
-Implemented VFX for "Flagon"
-World boundaries updated
-Enhanced AI movement
-Added new monster, with unique ability + VFX
-Added new small monster for early rounds
